name: Every Morning After
source:
Welcome, Zenith, to the Mana Regimen! You have been assigned to Dawn Halen, an intermediate mage presiding over your training. Why don’t you take your time getting to know each other? Maybe it’ll be the start of something new…

[From [url=https://ykwok.itch.io/every-morning-after]itch.io[/url]]
